clauses.requirement: General: the narrowband electromagnetic emission test method of UN R10 Annex 8 shall be applied to the ESA as set out in the following general provisions.

The test method of Annex 8 may be applied to ESAs that may be subsequently fitted to vehicles which comply with Annex 5; it concerns only ESAs other than those involved in 'REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid'.

The test shall measure narrowband electromagnetic emissions such as might emanate from a microprocessor-based system (e.g. the LED/PCB electronics of the rear lamp); unless otherwise stated in Annex 8, the test shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode during the tests, preferably at maximum load.
Test arrangements: the ESA narrowband emission test shall be set up according to the following provisions of Annex 8 paragraph 3.
The test shall be performed according to the ALSE (absorber lined shielded enclosure) method described in paragraph 6.4 of CISPR 25.
As an alternative to an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE), an open area test site (OATS) complying with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4 may be used (see Figure 1 of the appendix to Annex 7).

Ambient: to ensure no extraneous noise or signal of a magnitude sufficient to materially affect the measurement, ambient measurements shall be taken before or after the main test; the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the interference limits given in paragraph 6.6.2.1 of UN R10, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
